items.question: What was our GMV in November 2017?
items.text: Gross merchandise value (gmv) in 2017-11 was 1,172,191.68. Source: certified KPI gmv (Gross merchandise value), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), platform source https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1594805/000159480526000007/shop-20251231.htm; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT "month" AS grain_value, "gmv" AS kpi_value FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_gmv" WHERE TO_CHAR("month", 'YYYY-MM') = '2017-11' LIMIT 2

items.question: How much net revenue did we make in November 2017?
items.text: Net revenue (net merchandise sales) (net_revenue) in 2017-11 was 987,765.37. Source: certified KPI net_revenue (Net revenue (net merchandise sales)), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), accounting source https://www.ifrs.org/content/dam/ifrs/meetings/2014/july/trg-rev/rev-rec/ap2-gross-net-amounts-billed.pdf; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT "month" AS grain_value, "net_revenue" AS kpi_value FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_net_revenue" WHERE TO_CHAR("month", 'YYYY-MM') = '2017-11' LIMIT 2

items.question: What was the average order value in November 2017?
items.text: Average order value (aov) in 2017-11 was 135.27. Source: certified KPI aov (Average order value), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), platform source https://changelog.shopify.com/posts/your-average-order-value-now-has-a-new-definition-in-shopify; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT "month" AS grain_value, "aov" AS kpi_value FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_aov" WHERE TO_CHAR("month", 'YYYY-MM') = '2017-11' LIMIT 2

items.text: On-time delivery rate (on_time_delivery_rate) in 2017-11 was 0.876. items.sql: SELECT "month" AS grain_value, "on_time_delivery_rate" AS kpi_value FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_on_time_delivery_rate" WHERE TO_CHAR("month", 'YYYY-MM') = '2017-11' LIMIT 2

items.question: What was month-1 retention for the January 2017 cohort?
items.text: Monthly cohort retention (retention) for the 2017-01 cohort, 1 months after the first order was 0.004. Source: certified KPI cohort_retention (Monthly cohort retention), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), platform source https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/9670133?hl=en; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT "cohort_month" AS grain_value, "retention" AS kpi_value FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_cohort_retention" WHERE (TO_CHAR("cohort_month", 'YYYY-MM'), "months_since_first") = ('2017-01', 1) LIMIT 2

items.question: What is the 365-day customer lifetime value of the January 2017 cohort?
items.text: Historical customer lifetime value (clv_365d) for the 2017-01 cohort was 151.18. Source: certified KPI historical_clv (Historical customer lifetime value), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), platform source https://help.shopify.com/manual/reports-and-analytics/shopify-reports/report-types/customers-reports?r=ecm-bfs; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT "cohort_month" AS grain_value, "clv_365d" AS kpi_value FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_historical_clv" WHERE TO_CHAR("cohort_month", 'YYYY-MM') = '2017-01' LIMIT 2

items.question: What is our total GMV across all months?
items.text: Gross merchandise value (gmv) summed over all data over 24 periods is 15,735,527.03. Source: certified KPI gmv (Gross merchandise value), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), platform source https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1594805/000159480526000007/shop-20251231.htm; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT SUM("gmv") AS kpi_value, COUNT("gmv") AS periods FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_gmv" LIMIT 100

items.question: Which month had the highest GMV, and how much was it?
items.text: The highest Gross merchandise value (gmv) over all data was 1,172,191.68, in 2017-11. Source: certified KPI gmv (Gross merchandise value), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), platform source https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1594805/000159480526000007/shop-20251231.htm; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT "month" AS grain_value, "gmv" AS kpi_value FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_gmv" ORDER BY "gmv" DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1

items.question: What was our GMV for the whole of 2017?
items.text: Gross merchandise value (gmv) summed in 2017 over 12 periods is 7,090,569.24. Source: certified KPI gmv (Gross merchandise value), owner Amir Akhavan (analytics), platform source https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1594805/000159480526000007/shop-20251231.htm; certified by amir on 2026-11-05.
items.sql: SELECT SUM("gmv") AS kpi_value, COUNT("gmv") AS periods FROM "serve_analyst"."kpi_gmv" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "month") = 2017 LIMIT 100
